name: Public Service Admission Baseline
intended_use: 把公共 AI 服务的进入/测试/发布/退役判定提炼为机器可读、可复用的准入基准：任何服务对象可离线核验，判定不依赖方案自述。PSAB 由本方案的智脉四问（P1 可申报/P2 可测试/P3 可发布/P4 可退役）、11 字段服务护照、E0-E4 证据门、双闸门 G0-G7/C0-C7、8 状态机与四段退场红利合同提炼而成，作为与正文机制一一对应的机器可读规范。
origin: LShengYi/ai-pulse-belt proposal.md 第六章（脉冲协议）与 visual/assets/{implementation-gates,state-machine,dividend-contracts,simulation}.json
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (author's own normative content; no third-party clauses incorporated)

clauses.zh: 服务护照 11 项必填字段逐项完备（服务与地点/服务对象/非AI基线/数据上限/责任主体/运营主体/人工等价路径/成功证据/失败信号/申诉与暂停/退役与恢复）
clauses.en: Service passport: all 11 mandatory fields complete
clauses.noncompliance_zh: 缺项退回，不进入场景匹配与测试
clauses.noncompliance_en: Rejected; no admission to matching or testing

clauses.zh: P1 申报书为护照公开版本，五要素逐项核验记录公开
clauses.en: P1 application = public passport; five-element verification records public
clauses.noncompliance_zh: 核验记录缺失视为未申报
clauses.noncompliance_en: Missing verification record counts as unsubmitted

clauses.zh: 场景闸 C0-C7 与护照字段一一对应，缺项对应门不得放行
clauses.en: Scenario gates C0-C7 map 1:1 to passport fields; a missing field holds its gate

clauses.zh: 受控试点：预约、分区、现场安全员、实体急停、结束日期
clauses.en: Controlled pilot: booking, zoning, on-site safety officer, physical emergency stop, end date
clauses.noncompliance_zh: 保持日常模式，不进入受控开放
clauses.noncompliance_en: Stay in daily mode; no controlled opening

clauses.zh: 五类回滚触发器（安全/隐私/文保/经济/生态）任一触发即停机阀
clauses.en: Five rollback trigger classes (safety/privacy/heritage/economy/ecology); any trigger halts
clauses.noncompliance_zh: 触发即降级或停用，处置记录公开

clauses.zh: 人工等价路径在试点期实测可用（不用 AI 完成同一基本任务）
clauses.en: Same-task human route verified in pilot
clauses.noncompliance_zh: 实测不可用即不得上线
clauses.noncompliance_en: No launch while human route unavailable

clauses.zh: 三道异议门（公众委员会/受影响者/专业评审）无未决异议
clauses.en: Three objection gates clear of unresolved objections

clauses.zh: 五项公共底线指标全部达标（门槛+证据）
clauses.en: Five public bottom-line indicators met (threshold + evidence)
clauses.noncompliance_zh: 任一未达标降级回 P2 或停止
clauses.noncompliance_en: Any miss degrades to P2 or stops service

clauses.zh: E3 独立复测通过（原始与失败记录、人工接管、受影响人群意见、场地恢复）
clauses.en: E3 independent retest passed (raw & failure records, human takeover, affected-people input, site restoration)

clauses.zh: 四段退场红利合同完整：BASE（无AI基线）/BOOST（AI增益与边界）/BLACKOUT（停摆安排）/BEQUEST（退场契约）
clauses.noncompliance_zh: 无退场合同不得发布（15/15 全覆盖）
clauses.noncompliance_en: No exit contract, no release (15/15 coverage)

clauses.zh: 8 状态机转移必经停摆演练与退场审计（不可跳过）
clauses.en: State machine: blackout drill and bequest audit mandatory, non-skippable
clauses.noncompliance_zh: 跳过即状态机失效，全流程重验

clauses.zh: 退役即平线档案墙公开陈列（服务名/运行周期/复盘结论/失败记录匿名化）+ 数据与场地恢复确认
clauses.en: Retirement = public display on flatline archive wall + data/site restoration confirmation
clauses.noncompliance_zh: 未完成数据与场地恢复不得关闭档案
clauses.noncompliance_en: Archive stays open until restoration confirmed

clauses.zh: 运营证据门 E0-E4 控制推进，日历只安排顺序、不能代替任何一道门
clauses.en: Evidence gates E0-E4 gate all progress; calendars schedule order but never replace a gate

clauses.zh: 全部判定登记带独立回执哈希，可离线重跑（simulate-check.js 退出码契约 0/1/2）
clauses.en: Every determination carries a receipt hash, re-runnable offline (exit-code contract 0/1/2)
clauses.noncompliance_zh: 回执不可复算的主张不成立
clauses.noncompliance_en: Claims without reproducible receipts do not stand

clauses.zh: 复算纪律：展示值从全值截断，任何依赖计算从登记文件取值；旧计数不得直接引用
clauses.en: Recalculation discipline: display values truncate full values; dependent computations read registered files; stale counts are not citable
clauses.noncompliance_zh: 违反即对应主张降级待确认
clauses.noncompliance_en: Violation downgrades the claim to pending

passport_fields.missing_zh: 不得声称 AI 带来改善

open_items.title_zh: 护照字段集无数据跨境判定
open_items.title_en: Passport field set has no cross-border data clause
open_items.disposition_zh: 已登记自否推演回执（psab-drill.json）；规范 v1.0 保持原 11 字段并标注开放项，字段集修订（ADM-1 增补数据跨境声明）列为 v1.1 变更项，变更前跨境数据声明无必填承载
open_items.disposition_en: Registered in self-negation drill receipts; spec v1.0 keeps 11 fields and marks the item open; field-set revision (cross-border declaration in ADM-1) queued for v1.1

open_items.title_zh: E0 证据集无听证留档强制子句
open_items.title_en: E0 evidence set lacks mandatory hearing-archiving clause
open_items.disposition_zh: 已登记回执；E0 最少证据清单增补'公众委员会听证记录留档'列为 v1.1 变更项
open_items.disposition_en: Registered; 'hearing record archiving' addition to E0 minimum-evidence list queued for v1.1

open_items.title_zh: BOOST 段合同无增益分配登记项
open_items.title_en: BOOST segment has no gain-allocation field
open_items.disposition_zh: 已登记回执；'节省的时间由谁支付、增益归谁'在正文有原则表述（第十二章）但合同 schema 无承载字段，增补列为 v1.1 变更项
open_items.disposition_en: Registered; principle exists in narrative (Ch. 12) but contract schema lacks a field; addition queued for v1.1

evidence_contract.rerun_zh: node visual/assets/psab-validate.js（audit 模式核验 9 项真实服务；--drill 模式执行边界推演并重写 psab-drill.json）

exit_codes.1: 存在缺口（合规拒绝，按设计返回）

reuse_scenarios_zh: 其他公共 AI 服务提案可直接引用 PSAB 作为准入基线（CC BY-SA 4.0 规范文本）
评审端可离线对任意服务对象执行 audit 判定，不依赖本方案
城市更新后续运营可直接以 PSAB 子句作为服务合同前置条款
